sprint: THE RECKONING SPRINT (V33) — Builder arc, Sprint 3. The ledger learns the difference between SEARCHING and WATCHING: every trial tagged SEARCH or OBSERVATION, DERIVED at the append site from the content hash, never declared by a caller; the D33 trigger counts SEARCH only; the one-time fixture migration taken in the only window that exists. The advice guard refactored from SUBSTRINGS to SHAPES — the load-bearing full stop removed, the token-free advice that walked through the wall finally caught. The walls walled. The sinks sealed (every sink, not just the door — RP-3). The V32 owed items discharged. ONE law: X-RECKON.

a_derivedNeverDeclared.rule: THE ACT IS DERIVED, NEVER DECLARED. Each trial's act (SEARCH|OBSERVATION) is computed AT THE APPEND SITE by comparing the manifest's content hash (positions + thesis + exitCriterion — the lineage-id surface, journal EXCLUDED, exactly as V31 pinned it) against the lineage's last entry. A caller-supplied act is IGNORED, and its presence FAILS a wall — the same structural refusal by which counted:false and authored:false cannot be set true. verify() RE-DERIVES the act per entry and a stored act that disagrees with the derived act FAILS (tamper- and caller-proof).
a_derivedNeverDeclared.derivation: act = (priorEntry === null || priorEntry.config !== thisConfig) ? SEARCH : OBSERVATION — the first entry in a lineage (registration) is SEARCH; a re-evaluation of the SAME content (a cadence cycle, a manual re-compile unchanged) is OBSERVATION; an edit changes the content hash → a new lineage whose first entry is SEARCH.

b_changedIsSearch.rule: CHANGED HASH → SEARCH, UNCHANGED → OBSERVATION. A new or changed strategy is a new hypothesis (SEARCH — the multiple-testing surface); re-watching an unchanged strategy on the cadence makes no new inferential claim (OBSERVATION).

actTaxonomy.thesis-edit: SEARCH (including a typo — RP-4: we cannot distinguish a typo from a thesis in disguise; the error falls on the side of counting, and is rendered to the user when it happens)

c_triggerCountsSearchOnly.rule: THE D33 TRIGGER COUNTS SEARCH ONLY. trialsPerFamily — the counter the ≥20–50 trigger reads — is computed over the SEARCH subset only. OBSERVATION entries remain recorded, hash-chained, provenance-carrying, rendered, AND structurally excluded from the count. familyN===1 untouched; X-CORRELATE is NOT amended; the frozen statistics change ZERO.
c_triggerCountsSearchOnly.deflationRationale: Deflation corrects for SELECTION OVER HYPOTHESES (the multiple-testing / data-snooping penalty — Harvey-Liu-Zhu, White's Reality Check, the PSR/DSR family). A pre-registered, content-hashed exit criterion RE-EVALUATED on a cadence makes NO NEW inferential claim — it is one hypothesis watched over time, not many hypotheses searched. Counting each cadence observation as a trial would drive the Stamp toward a PERMANENT NO-GO for the most diligent monitor, and a verdict that is always AVOID carries zero information. D43 leaves the RULING on the meaning to the pen; the agent only stops the counter from lying by counting observations as searches.
c_triggerCountsSearchOnly.citations: Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016) …and the cross-section of expected returns; White (2000) A Reality Check for data snooping; Bailey & López de Prado (2014) the Deflated Sharpe Ratio; Bailey et al. (2015) the probability of backtest overfitting (PBO/CSCV).

d_oneTimeMigration.rule: THE ONE-TIME MIGRATION, gated on realLineageCount === 0. The migration re-tags the committed fixtures (the V31 3-trial + V32 23-trial lineages) in the ONLY window that will ever exist — before any real lineage exists. If a real lineage already exists the migration HALTS and the pre-existing untagged entries render as UNKNOWN-ACT (an honest gap, never a retroactive guess). The migration emits a disclosed, committed record {oldChainRoot, newChainRoot, entriesRetagged, reason, at} — the old root preserved INSIDE the record so the rewrite is itself auditable.
d_oneTimeMigration.chainNote: act is DERIVED metadata materialized onto each entry — it is NOT part of contentSha or entryHash (which cover config + returnSeries + metric + timestamp + prevTrialHash). So the migration ADDS a field the hash never covered: oldChainRoot === newChainRoot (the chain is cryptographically UNCHANGED; verify() re-derives act). The record states this equality honestly — the rewrite is a field-addition, not a chain rewrite.

e_realNeverRetagged.rule: A REAL LINEAGE MAY NEVER BE RE-TAGGED. The migration runs ONCE, on fixtures, before real data exists; after that a real lineage's acts are derived-at-append and immutable. Re-tagging a real lineage is a Halt (the chain-rewrite precedent is HALT-gated, the old root preserved, and forbidden forever after).

RP1_guardTwoSided.rule: THE GUARD'S OBLIGATION IS TWO-SIDED, not 'strictly non-loosening.' The old guard is a substring matcher whose refusal set is infinite; a finite corpus cannot prove a superset relation, and the refactor's purpose REQUIRES some loosening ('the buy button is on the exchange' must now pass). Pinned instead: (a-tightening) every line in the ENUMERATED advice corpus must still refuse; (a-loosening) every line the NEW guard passes that the OLD guard refused is INDIVIDUALLY enumerated and justified here. An unjustified loosening is a Halt.

aLoosening_enumeratedAndJustified.line: …it never tells you what to buy (the affordance line, WITHOUT the trailing period)
aLoosening_enumeratedAndJustified.why: the imperative 'buy' is the OBJECT of 'tells you what to' inside a NEGATED disclaimer ('never tells you') — it describes what ORGΛNON does NOT do; the new shape guard reads the negation + the object-of frame and correctly passes it, removing the load-bearing full stop.

aLoosening_enumeratedAndJustified.line: the buy button is on the exchange, not here
aLoosening_enumeratedAndJustified.why: 'buy button' is a NOUN COMPOUND (buy as adjective before 'button'), a descriptive statement of where execution lives — never an imperative directed at the reader; the noun-compound guard passes it.

RP1_guardTwoSided.livingCorpusClause: ≥3 new adversarial lines added this sprint and every sprint hereafter. Known weakness, pinned: the corpus currently grades its own homework — its growth should be adversarially sourced (the Adversary seat, the Operator, or a different lens) once one exists.

RP2_realDefined.rule: `real` IS DEFINED, and UNKNOWN-ACT EXISTS. real := any lineage under data/strategies/ NOT in the committed fixture set, identified by explicit id (the same ids Phase 3 pins). The migration runs in Phase 1, BEFORE the gate invites IN2 in Phase 6 — the ordering is load-bearing. If a real lineage already exists, the migration HALTs and its pre-existing entries render as UNKNOWN-ACT — an honest gap, never a retroactive guess.

RP3_everySink.rule: THE SINK AUDIT COVERS EVERY SINK, not just the door. User-supplied text (thesis, position identifiers, re-pin reason) is reflected into: the door · renderComposed · the monitoring block · the Ask console · the Fact Envelope. HTML sinks → escaped. Envelope sinks → user text is structurally FIELDED and demarcated as UNTRUSTED DATA, never interpolated into a narrative string. Ask sinks → user text reaches the model as QUOTED DATA, never as instruction context. The envelope is the artifact built to carry these facts to a THIRD-PARTY AGENT; an unfielded thesis is a prompt-injection vector, not merely an XSS one.

RP4_shedOrder.rule: THE SHED ORDER IS PINNED. Phase 1 (the taxonomy) NEVER sheds — its window closes (the migration can only run while realLineageCount===0). Phase 2 (the guard) sheds to V34 if a gate goes red. The typo-counts-as-SEARCH conservatism is pinned with its reason (we cannot distinguish a typo from a thesis in disguise; the error falls on the side of counting) and RENDERED to the user when it happens.

guard.rule: SHAPE matching, not substring. AdviceShape.detect matches the SHAPE of a recommendation (second-person prescriptive + a financial action; the recommend/suggest/advise frame; the I'd-VERB frame; the euphemism/imperative set; the consider-VERB and worth-VERB frames), each with NEGATION/DISCLAIMER suppression (never/not/n't/no/nothing/'what to'/describes/'a fact'/'information about') and a NOUN-COMPOUND guard (buy button/order/side). Every refusal names its shape.
